effectiveTerms: MIT, BSD-3-Clause, the MAME licence and the fmgen terms, together
commercialUse: prohibited: the MAME licence of the sound drivers forbids selling the package or using it in a commercial product or activity, and fmgen needs its author's consent for commercial software
note: The built core combines this repository's MIT integration with QUASI88 (BSD-3-Clause), the MAME/XMAME sound drivers QUASI88 carries (the old MAME licence) and fmgen (the fmgen terms). The MAME licence asks that a modified build be distributed with its complete source: the source of every part is linked below by exact commit, and this repository holds the changes (patches/ and waterbox/). fmgen's terms allow free modification and distribution if the origin is named, the result stays free software, changes are stated and its text is kept unchanged.

components.name: QUASI88 (bubio's SDL2 port of Showzoh Fukunaga's PC-8801 emulator)
MAME/XMAME sound drivers (src/snddrv/xmame)
components.note: The YM2203, YM2608, AY-3-8910 and mixing code QUASI88 takes from XMAME 0.106.
